errorSignature: GitHub Actions account billing lock; Knip unused exports; CSS token sprawl; unvalidated JSON configs
rootCause: GitHub Actions billing lock blocked all CI. Knip found 6 unused exports. Fallow found 219 distinct colors and token sprawl. JSON configs lacked automated syntax validation.
resolution: Added .gitlab-ci.yml (self-hosted runner) + Vercel build gating + validate-json (152 files) + Knip export cleanup + CSS tokenization priority order + spec-driven-implementer agent. Consolidated tracers appended to AGENT_TRACER.md files.
preventionRule: When GitHub Actions is billing-locked, use pnpm ci:local + Vercel build gating + .gitlab-ci.yml for merge evidence. Run pnpm validate:json in pre-commit and CI. Remove Knip-unused exports by dropping export. Tokenize CSS in priority order per docs/specs/CSS_TOKENIZATION_ORDER.md (colors -> font sizes -> radius -> z-index -> shadows -> unused vars), one level per spec/PR, verified by audit:tokens + a11y + visual e2e.
